env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos run .
stdout '^hello$'

logos build .

# Plain go detects the LoGOs module and re-executes as logos.
go build .
go run .
stdout '^hello$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/hello

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello")
}
